get.description:
Get CDRs belonging to the owner, either CPO or EMSP. CDRs are usually available near real-time. The maximum number of records to return in the response is 1000. You should use the link value in the response header to fetch next pages.

**Pagination:**
- Version 1.0: Uses offset-based pagination with the `offset` parameter
- Version 2.0: Uses token-based pagination with the `continuationToken` parameter

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only return CDRs that have last_updated after or equal to this Date/Time (inclusive)

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Only return CDRs that have last_updated up to this Date/Time, but not including (exclusive)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of objects to GET. Default is 1000. Also the maximum limit is 1000 records. If you set a bigger number than 1000, we only returns maximum of 1000 records in the response.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: [Version 1.0 only] The offset of the first object returned. Default is 0. This parameter is not available in version 2.0, use continuationToken instead.

parameters.name: continuation_token
parameters.description: [Version 2.0 only] Continuation token for pagination. Use the token from the previous response to get the next page of results. This parameter is not available in version 1.0, use offset instead.

Link.description: [Version 2.0 only] URL to retrieve the next page of CDRs. Only present when there are more results available. This header is not available in version 1.0.
